text:
marie_sales: Heads up team, BetaCorp sent over a SIG/CAIQ + a 12-page security questionnaire tied to the enterprise SOW. They want answers before we kick off the POC. Can security triage and we9ll confirm POC environment (VPC vs Dedicated) quickly?

anya_security: Upload the file please. I9ll intake and open a vendor risk ticket. We should scope for data classification and any encryption/KMS asks first.

marie_sales: Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BetaSIG (internal). They also want 30-day logs retention and an exportable audit trail for the POC. POC will mimic prod traffic.

felix_se: If they9re mimicking prod, recommend Private or Dedicated with strict VPC peering and egress controls. We need to know if they9re providing test data with PII.

tom_support: Note: Our Hosted offering limits logs retention to 7 days without the add-on. For Dedicated/Private we can increase retention, but there are costs.

anya_security: Creating ticket now. Ticket details:
- Summary: "BetaCorp SIG intake for POC"
- Assignee: anya_security
- Due: 2025-11-21 EOD

sec-bot: Ticket VR-2025-350 created and assigned to anya_security: https://our-issues.internal/VR-2025-350

felix_se: I'll draft the POC architecture doc after the security baseline is approved. Need to confirm whether they require HSM-backed keys or if KMS integration is ok.

marie_sales: They requested a discount and asked if we can cover some of the POC infra costs. Any guidance?

anya_security: Pricing decisions are not mine, but note any infra deviations in the ticket so Sales can quantify cost delta. I'll tag legal for data residency and contract-specific questions.

tom_support: Quick canned answers we can reuse: 
- Encryption: TLS1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest. 
- Key management: Customer-managed keys available on Dedicated/Private.
- Audit: Audit logs available via API with role-based access.

anya_security: ETA: first-pass answers in 24 hours, final answers by 48 hours if no escalations. If we find a blocker, will escalate to security leadership.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "BetaCorp security sync" tomorrow 11:00 PT with anya_security, felix_se, marie_sales.

marie_sales: I'll confirm PII status with BetaCorp and paste it to the ticket.

felix_se: Also capturing the request for exportable audit trail - we may need to add a small integration to push logs to their SIEM during POC.

anya_security: Please add any SIEM/export requirements to the ticket. I'll produce a mapping of SIG sections to our control attestations and highlight gaps.

marie_sales: Thanks all. I'll update customer with initial ack: "Received, security triage in progress; expect first-pass answers in 24hrs." :thumbsup:
